fusions.name: Parting Ways
fusions.desc: Looses 2 jaws in diverging paths, each dealing 12 damage and knocking the target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Crossroads Tithe
fusions.desc: A jab that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Wrong Turn
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source, for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Prong
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your next 2 spells deal 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
